subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram DMs can still land in agent:main:main, polluting heartbeat/main session after #40519

question: Should #41165 be split so the heartbeat wake precedence bug lands first while Telegram DM default isolation remains a separate compatibility decision?
rationale: The heartbeat precedence path is a clear bug, but changing default Telegram DMs away from documented main-session sharing would alter existing behavior.

options.title: Split Heartbeat Fix First
options.body: Adopt or replace the heartbeat wake/session fix so `heartbeat.session` wins, and leave Telegram DM defaults controlled by `session.dmScope` until a separate decision.

options.title: Bundle Telegram Isolation
options.body: Change Telegram DMs to isolate by default in the same work, accepting the docs and upgrade impact for users relying on main-session continuity.

options.title: Defer To Heartbeat Entries
options.body: Hold the bug behind native per-session heartbeat scheduling, which may be cleaner long term but leaves the current forced-session path unresolved.

recommendation.title: Split Heartbeat Fix First
recommendation.body: Adopt or replace the heartbeat wake/session fix so `heartbeat.session` wins, and leave Telegram DM defaults controlled by `session.dmScope` until a separate decision.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice spans heartbeat runtime behavior and compatibility-sensitive routing policy, and Peter introduced the unified runner history used here.
